lines.en: : Uhh...Senpai?
lines.zh: : 呃……Senpai?

lines.en: : Yeah?
: So, remember how I got wrapped up in the emotional dialogue back on the beach and agreed to show you my swimsuit? Is it too late to take that back?
lines.zh: : 就是说,还记得在海边我被那段掏心窝子的对话裹挟、答应给你看我的泳衣吗?现在收回还来得及吗?

lines.en: : You’ve come this far. What will you gain by keeping things the same way they have been?
lines.zh: : 你都走到这一步了。维持原样,你又能得到什么?

lines.en: : I mean, it’s less about gaining and more about just not losing anything. I’ve still got a little bit of dignity left, you know? Like, do I really want to be stripping for my superior?
lines.zh: : 就是说,重点不是得到,而是别失去什么。我仅剩的自尊还有一点点,你知道吗?就是说,我真的想给上司脱衣服吗?

lines.en: : I’m just a friend right now, Imani. And I’m a friend who wants to see you the way you really are.
lines.zh: : 我现在只是个朋友,Imani。而是一个想看看真实的你的朋友。

lines.en: : But who we really are is all about what’s on the inside, right? Which means I get to keep my clothes on.
lines.zh: : 可「真实的我们」看的不是内在吗?所以我可以不脱。

lines.en: : Just come out, Imani.
lines.zh: : 快出来吧,Imani。

lines.en: : Ugghhhh...give me another minute. I’ve got matching earrings I have to find first.
lines.zh: : 唉————……再给我一分钟。我还有一对配套的耳环得先找到。

lines.en: So, we’re back.
lines.zh: 于是,我们回来了。

lines.en: Wakana and Osako haven’t returned yet. And based on whatever the result of their talk may be, I’m not sure if they will.
lines.zh: Wakana 和 Osako 还没回来。而根据她们那场谈话可能的结果,我不确定她们还会不会回来。

lines.en: I don’t have much to say about Imani’s story.
lines.zh: 关于 Imani 的故事,我没有多少可说的。

lines.en: I mean...what could I say that wouldn’t just make it seem like I’m jumping through hoops to be able to relate to her?
lines.zh: 就是说……我能说什么?说出口,不都像是我在上蹿下跳地强行共情她吗?

lines.en: And since I can’t even begin to imagine what she went through back then...I won’t.
lines.zh: 而既然我连想象她当年经历了什么都做不到……那我就不说。

lines.en: I’ll keep doing what I’ve been doing from the start in seeing her not as an animal, but as one of the most driven and beautiful people I’ve ever come across.
lines.zh: 我会继续做我从一开始就在做的事:不把她看作动物,而是把我此生见过最有干劲、最美丽的几个人之一。

lines.en: Nothing changes after today.
lines.zh: 今天之后,什么都不会变。

lines.en: Well...
Something might.
lines.zh: 也许有一样会。

lines.en: But it’s something I’ve been silently agonizing over for the last several hours and there’s no point in telling you when you’ll find out soon enough.
lines.zh: 但那是过去几个小时里我一直在无声煎熬的东西——你很快就会知道,现在说出来毫无意义。

lines.en: She exits the bedroom...but she asked me to face the entrance while she got changed so I wouldn’t wind up seeing her before she’s ready.
lines.zh: 她从卧室里出来了……不过换衣服时,她让我面向玄关,免得在她准备好之前我就看见她。

lines.en: But knowing Imani, she might just stand behind me for the rest of the night.
lines.zh: 可 Imani 这个人,说不定今晚剩下的时间都会站在我背后。

lines.en: I really hope she won’t, though. I want to see with my own two eyes what haunts her more than anything.
lines.zh: 不过我真心希望她不会。我想亲眼看看,究竟是什么比什么都更纠缠着她。

lines.en: Our true colors come out when we have to face our fears, you know. And tonight I learned that the reason she’s so vibrant is because she carries hers with her every minute of every day. But never in their purest form.
lines.zh: 人直面恐惧的时候,才会露出真容,你知道吗。而今晚我了解到,她之所以那样鲜亮,是因为她每一天的每一分钟都带着她的恐惧。只是从来不用最赤裸的形态。

lines.en: So while one door opened behind me just a few seconds ago, another one opened in the back of my mind.
lines.zh: 于是,就在我身后的一扇门打开的几秒后,我脑海深处也有一扇门开了。

lines.en: I can’t see what’s inside. I need a light to guide me.
lines.zh: 我看不见里面有什么。我需要一盏灯。

lines.en: : Okay...here I come.
lines.zh: : 好……我来了。

lines.en: So I will carry her with me — to places I have only dreamt of reaching — in hopes that one day, I will be vibrant too.
lines.zh: 所以,我会背负着她——去那些我只在梦里抵达过的地方——盼着有朝一日,我也能鲜亮起来。

lines.en: : I’m proud of you, Imani.
lines.zh: : 我为你骄傲,Imani。

lines.en: : Oh, shut up...If I wanted you to get all sappy on me, I’d have let you speak when I was force-feeding you my  sob story on the beach.
lines.zh: : 哦,闭嘴……要是我想让你对我煽情,在海边我硬灌你那段苦情故事的时候,我就让你开口了。

lines.en: : I won’t say any more...just that I’m proud.
lines.zh: : 我不会再多说了……只是骄傲。

lines.en: : Th...Thank you, Senpai...
lines.zh: : 谢……谢谢,Senpai……

lines.en: : If only I’d have had the guts to show you sooner. Maybe then we could have gone swimming today? We sure had enough time to kill.
lines.zh: : 你要是有胆早点给我看就好了。那样的话,我们今天说不定还能去游泳?我们杀掉的时间可真够多。

lines.en: : I’m not much of a swimmer. I wouldn’t mind watching you, though.
lines.zh: : 我不太会游泳。不过看你游,我不介意。

lines.en: : No thanks. It’s a little worse from behind. This is...more than enough for now.
lines.zh: : 不必了。背面更惨一点。这个……眼下已经够看了。

lines.en: : I’m not the first to know, am I?
lines.zh: : 我不是第一个知道的人,对吧?

lines.en: : The rest of our friend group knows since we’ve gone to the bathhouse together. Other than you guys, though...there’s Futaba, Yumi, and Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我们朋友圈里的其他人因为一起去过澡堂所以都知道。除了你们俩……还有 Futaba、Yumi,和 Ayane。

lines.en: : One of those things is not like the other.
lines.zh: : 其中一个和别的不是一类。

lines.en: : If you’re referring to Yumi, she walked in on me getting changed a while back. Ayane found out the same way in the locker room a few months ago, but...she didn’t even react so...I don’t know if she really saw?
lines.zh: : 你说的是 Yumi 吧,她之前撞见我在换衣服。Ayane 几个月前在更衣室里也一样,但是……她一点反应都没有,所以……我不确定她到底算不算看见了?

lines.en: : Nah, she’s just the type of girl who wouldn’t react even if she did. What about Futaba, though? What’d she have to say?
lines.zh: : 不,她就是那种看见了也不会有反应的女孩。那 Futaba 呢?她说了什么?

lines.en: : You’re worried about her too, huh?
lines.zh: : 你也在担心她,啊?

lines.en: : I never said that.
lines.zh: : 我可没说。

lines.en: : Yeah, but I can already tell you’re thinking, “Hey! Two girls with body issues. They can probably get along.” And to that...you’re right. Kind of.
lines.zh: : 是,但我已经能猜到你在想什么了——「嘿!两个有身材焦虑的女孩。她们大概合得来。」对此……你说对了。算是吧。

lines.en: : Our issues are a little different, but we did share a sentimental and very nude moment together in which we reassured one another of our respective beauty.
lines.zh: : 我们的疙瘩不太一样,但我们的确共同拥有过一个非常感伤、非常赤裸的时刻——我们在里面互相保证,对方很美。

lines.en: : Oh, and also, we held a scavenger hunt for the Dorm Wars this year and she chose me when her card had “something beautiful” on it. I died a little. I love her.
lines.zh: : 哦,还有,今年宿舍大战我们办了寻宝游戏,她的卡片上写着「一样美丽的东西」,她选了我。我魂飞了一小截。我爱她。

lines.en: : Keep looking out for her, please. I’ve been trying to help her with that forever and I’ve made virtually no progress whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 请继续照看她,拜托了。那件事我帮她帮了永远那么久,几乎没有取得任何进展。

lines.en: : Don’t worry, Senpai. I’m looking after everyone. Everyone who will let me, that is.
lines.zh: : 别担心,Senpai。我在照看着每一个人。每一个允许我照看的人,就是说。

lines.en: : What kind of man would I be if I let you look after me on top of everyone else? You’ve got enough on your plate.
lines.zh: : 要是让你在照看所有人之余连我也照看,那我还算什么男人?你盘子里的已经够多了。

lines.en: : Stop that.
lines.zh: : 别这样。

lines.en: : Stop what?
lines.zh: : 别哪样?

lines.en: : That whole “I don’t want to burden you” crap. I told you I got you, didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 那一套「我不想成为你的负担」的屁话。我说过我罩着你,不是吗?

lines.en: : Yeah...
: I’ve got you too.
lines.zh: : 我也罩着你。

lines.en: : Thanks...
lines.zh: : 谢了……

lines.en: : Oh! I got so wrapped up in sentimentality that I almost forgot to ask. How do you like the swimsuit?
lines.zh: : 哦!我光顾着煽情,差点忘了问。这件泳衣你觉得怎么样?

lines.en: : It’s beautiful. Now, take it off.
lines.zh: : 很美。现在,把它脱了。

lines.en: : Thanks! I actually found this business downtown that-
lines.zh: : 谢啦!其实我在市中心找到一家店,它——

lines.en: : Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等,什么?

lines.en: : The man said “take it off,” damn it!
lines.zh: : 人家说了「把它脱了」,该死的!

lines.en: : Wakana?!
lines.zh: : Wakana?!

lines.en: : Wakana, don’t interrupt them! Things were finally going somewhere!
lines.zh: : Wakana,别打断他们!事情好不容易有进展了!

lines.en: : Wha- where did you two even come from?!
lines.zh: : 什——你们俩到底是从哪冒出来的?!

lines.en: : Like hell things were going somewhere! These two are so destined for abstinence that they’d have talked themselves right out of it! Strip!
lines.zh: : 进展个鬼!这两个注定禁欲——他们能把自己当场说服到放弃!脱!

lines.en: : Wha...no?!?! I heard what he said too, but...Senpai clearly meant something else! He probably just wants a better look at my body since it’s like...fifty percent art project!
lines.zh: : 什……不?!?!我也听到他说的了,可是……Senpai 显然是别的意思!他大概只是想再仔细看看我的身体,毕竟它有点……百分之五十是艺术项目!

lines.en: : I can get a better look at it while going down on you.
lines.zh: : 我一边给你口一边能看得更仔细。

lines.en: : While doing what?!?!
lines.zh: : 一边干什么?!?!

lines.en: : Yes, Arakawa! You’ve finally chosen the correct moment to be a depraved son of a bitch!
lines.zh: : 没错,Akira!你终于选对时机当一回下流坯子了!

lines.en: : Senpai, seriously?! Isn’t this too soon?!
lines.zh: : Senpai,认真的?!这是不是太快了?!

lines.en: : Too soon?! You’ve been fantasizing about this moment since you first met! And you’ve been complaining about him not screwing you for even longer!
lines.zh: : 太快?!你从初次见面起就在幻想这一刻!而你抱怨他不肯上你,更是比这还久!

lines.en: : That’s not even possible! That was also before he agreed and now I’m all nervous!
lines.zh: : 那根本不可能!那也是在他答应之前,而且我现在紧张得要死!

lines.en: : Be nervous another time! Because I’ll be damned if I let you miss out on this opportunity and have to listen to you bitch about it for the next seven years!
lines.zh: : 紧张下次再紧张!因为要是让你错过这次机会、还得听你接下来七年里为此碎碎念,我宁愿下地狱!

lines.en: : Wha- where are you pushing me?!
lines.zh: : 什——你把我往哪推?!

lines.en: : The bedroom! Arakawa, come!
lines.zh: : 卧室!Akira,跟上!

lines.en: : I feel like this is getting a little too close to-
lines.zh: : 我觉得这有点太接近——

lines.en: : Shut the fuck up and get over here!
lines.zh: : 闭他妈的嘴,快过来!

lines.en: : Sorry, coming.
lines.zh: : 抱歉,来了。

lines.en: : Ugh...do we have anything left to drink?
lines.zh: : 唉……我们还有喝的剩吗?

lines.en: Osako and I follow Wakana as she somehow manages to force Imani into the bedroom, but I’m not quite sure if she’s accomplished this thanks to her new painkillers or the power of friendship.
lines.zh: Osako 和我跟着 Wakana——她不知怎么硬是把 Imani 弄进了卧室。而我不太确定,她是靠新止痛药,还是靠友谊的力量达成的。

lines.en: I’m leaning toward the latter, to be honest. Because I’m sure some of it was just diversionary, but Wakana’s been more gung-ho about me hooking up with Imani than Imani has today.
lines.zh: : 老实说,我倾向后者。因为可以肯定其中一部分只是声东击西,但 Wakana 对「我和 Imani 上床」的干劲,比 Imani 本人今天还足。

lines.en: And I just don’t have it in me to refuse her anymore.
lines.zh: : 而我已经没有拒绝她的心力了。

lines.en: Yes, I wanted a friend. Yes, I wanted someone to be by my side without having to fall back on sex. And yes, I wanted Imani to be that person because I think she’s capable of so much more without me.
lines.zh: : 是,我想要一个朋友。是,我想要一个不必靠性维系的、陪在我身边的人。是,我想要 Imani 成为那个人——因为我认为,没有我,她本可以做到更多。

lines.en: But that sort of multi-leveled thinking has never even come close to working for me since distancing myself from anyone seems nigh fucking impossible.
lines.zh: : 可这种多层次的思考,从来就没在我身上成功过——因为想和任何人拉开距离,都他妈近乎不可能。

lines.en: So I think back to Ayane...I think back to Chika...I think back to Makoto and Futaba and realize that some of the most important relationships in my life have stemmed from diving headfirst into sex.
lines.zh: : 所以我想起 Ayane……想起 Chika……想起 Makoto 和 Futaba,并意识到:我人生中一些最重要的关系,恰恰源于一头扎进性里。

lines.en: Did I really fool myself into thinking I could do things differently with her? It was never going to work that way.
lines.zh: : 我真以为自己能骗过自己、和她用不同的方式相处?它从来不会那样运作。

lines.en: This is what I’m good for and this is what I know how to do. Neglecting that by thinking I know what’s better for her or that I’m an actual person with person-like needs is pointless.
lines.zh: : 这就是我擅长的事,这就是我会做的事。想着「我知道什么对她更好」、想着「我是一个有人的需求的真正的人」,从而怠慢它——毫无意义。

lines.en: It’s all pointless.
lines.zh: : 一切都毫无意义。

lines.en: So I will now spread her legs and bring her to orgasm with my mouth in act of apologetic submission.
lines.zh: : 所以,我现在要分开她的双腿,用我的嘴让她登上顶点,以一场满怀歉意的臣服。

lines.en: It’s only right, you know.
lines.zh: : 理所应当,你知道吧。

lines.en: : Chill the fuck out, yo! You’re gonna rip it!
lines.zh: : 冷静点,你!你要把它撕坏了!

lines.en: : I wouldn’t have to rip it at all if you’d just take it off!
lines.zh: : 你要是肯自己脱,我才不用撕!

lines.en: : You’re messin’ with the wrong girl, Wakana! HR will hear about this!
lines.zh: : 你惹错人了,Wakana!HR 会听说这件事的!

lines.en: : Well, we’ll see if you still want to call them after Arakawa puts his filthy, God-forsaken hands on you!
lines.zh: : 嗯,等 Arakawa 把他肮脏的、被神遗弃的手放你身上之后,我们再看你还要不要投诉!

lines.en: : Hey, I just washed them a few minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 嘿,我几分钟前刚洗过。

lines.en: : Osako! A little help here?! You’re strong! Get this woman off of me!
lines.zh: : Osako!搭把手?!你力气大!把这个女人从我身上弄下去!

lines.en: : Are you sure you want me to, Imani?
lines.zh: : 你确定要我这么做吗,Imani?

lines.en: : I don’t know what I want! This is all happening so fast!
lines.zh: : 我不知道我想要什么!这一切发生得太快了!

lines.en: : NO IT’S FUCKING NOT! THIS IS WHAT WE’VE BEEN BUILDING TOWARD!
lines.zh: : 快个屁!这就是我们一路铺垫的目标!

lines.en: : STOP YELLING AT ME! I HAVE SENSITIVE EARS!
lines.zh: : 别冲我吼!我的耳朵很敏感!

lines.en: : Hey. Now wouldn’t be the best time for me to ask about how your “walk” went, would it?
lines.zh: : 嘿。现在问我「散步」进行得怎么样,恐怕不是最好的时机吧?

lines.en: : Are you kidding? Absolutely not.
lines.zh: : 你开玩笑吧?绝对不是。

lines.en: : Yeah, I thought so. But can you at least give me a thumbs up or thumbs down to summarize it?
lines.zh: : 是,我就知道。但至少给我竖个拇指或拇指朝下总结一下?

lines.en: : I guess like this?
lines.zh: : 我猜……是这样?

lines.en: : Well, that doesn’t help me at all.
lines.zh: : 嗯,这对我毫无帮助。

lines.en: : Help with what? This is our issue, not yours.
lines.zh: : 帮什么忙?这是我们俩的问题,不是你的。

lines.en: : Oh, I know. But you two have had no qualms whatsoever with trying to wrap yourselves up in my issues, so I figured it would be okay if I maybe worried about your relationship. If that’s okay with you, I mean.
lines.zh: : 哦,我知道。可你们俩此前毫不犹豫地把自己卷进我的问题里,所以我寻思,我关心一下你们的感情关系,应该也没问题。我是说,如果你们不介意的话。

lines.en: : Oh, shit...
: Yeah, I haven't forgotten about that.
lines.zh: : 是,我没有忘记那件事。

lines.en: : I'm sorry, man...So much has been going on lately that I've just...
lines.zh: : 对不起,老兄……最近发生的事太多,我只是……

lines.en: : I'm sorry. I shouldn't have said anything.
lines.zh: : 对不起。我不该提的。

lines.en: : Apology accepted. Now, leave it alone. And also tell me if you two are going to be okay because it’s messing with my head.
lines.zh: : 道歉接受。现在,别再提了。另外,告诉我你们俩到底会不会没事,因为这事搅得我头晕。

lines.en: : It’s bothering you that much?...
lines.zh: : 它让你这么烦?……

lines.en: : Everything is bothering me now and I honestly can’t stand it. Since when do I have so many feelings? And how come all of them fucking suck?
lines.zh: : 现在一切都让我烦,而且说实话我忍无可忍。我从什么时候起有这么多情绪了?而且怎么全他妈烂透了?

lines.en: : I don’t have the answer to that, but...if you want my advice-
lines.zh: : 这题我答不上来,但……如果你想要我的建议——

lines.en: : Ah-hah!
lines.zh: : 抓到了!

lines.en: : Wakana! Give me back my swimsuit!
lines.zh: : Wakana!把我的泳衣还给我!

lines.en: : Never!
lines.zh: : 想都别想!

lines.en: : How did you even manage to get my top and bottom off?! What kind of sex wizard are you?!
lines.zh: : 你是怎么把我的上下两件都扒掉的?!你到底是什么样的性爱巫师?!

lines.en: : Never underestimate my ability to get a woman’s clothes off!
lines.zh: : 永远不要低估我扒女人衣服的本事!

lines.en: : Arakawa. Seize her.
lines.zh: : Arakawa。拿下她。

lines.en: : Aaaaah! What a terrible time to come full circle! Don’t seize me!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊!什么叫冤家路窄!别拿下我!

lines.en: : Imani. Look at me.
lines.zh: : Imani。看着我。

lines.en: : I’m the captain now.
lines.zh: : 现在,舰长是我。

lines.en: : No shot. Boutta finally get some action after almost a decade and he hits me with a quote from a Tom Hanks movie. Ain’t no way.
lines.zh: : 不会吧。将近十年没开张,终于要有动静了,他给我来了一句 Tom Hanks 电影的台词。没门。

lines.en: : Seriously, Arakawa? Am I going to have to strip you next?
lines.zh: : 认真的吗,Arakawa?下一步是不是该轮到我扒你了?

lines.en: : Sorry. What I meant to say is-
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我真正想说的是——

lines.en: : Everything’s fine. There’s no need to pause and try to wrap your head around why I’ve changed my mind when I did.
lines.zh: : 一切都没问题。你不必停下来绞尽脑汁,去想我为什么在那时改变了主意。

lines.en: : It isn’t out of pity and it isn’t going to change what we are.
lines.zh: : 那不是出于怜悯,它也不会改变我们「是什么」。
